profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Pazien, Inc.
profile.summary:
A proficient full stack engineer with more than 10 years of experience in developing enterprise-scale, distributed applications using Java, Spring, Scripting Languages and AWS. 

Having worked with product development companies as a lead engineer and senior consultant with top IT services firms, I demonstrate strong engineering and customer facing skills.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Prioritizing the product backlog and developing new features by following agile development life cycle
    • Managing the product release cycle - cutting the patches, rolling out the changes and backout strategy
    • Working with Customer Success Team to address high priority customer issues
    • Mentoring junior developers and interns; Imparting training on Percussion’s product suite
    • Technology stack: Java, JavaScript, JQuery, XML/XSLT, Spring, AWS (DynamoDB, SNS, SES, Redis Cache), Jetty

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developing product features using Java, JSP and Hibernate
    • Writing complex SQL queries and stored procedures to extract custom reports
    • Technology stack: Java, JSP, Hibernate, Oracle (SQL/PLSQL)

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description:
• Working with customer stakeholders and analysts for elaborating requirements specifications by evaluating technology solutions and prototyping
    • Creating work breakdown structure, assigning tasks to junior developers and tracking the assigned work units 
    • Developing the core modules and integration adapters
    • Conducting design and code reviews; assisting team for troubleshooting and resolving technical challenges
    • Technology stack: Java, Spring, XML/XSLT, JavaScript, Content Management Systems (FatWire, Stellent), JBoss, Oracle

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developing web applications using Enterprise Java and Documentum
    • Working with teams across geographies and ensuring the project delivery per customer’s requirements
    • As a SME (Subject Matter Expert) on Documentum, imparting training and advising on development activities across multiple projects
    • Technology stack: Documentum, Java, Struts, EJB, JSP, Oracle

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developing custom workflow application and geographical information system
    • Participating in requirement analysis and design sessions
    • Technology stack: Java (Swing), Applet, PostgreSQL, Tomcat
